source.verification_notes: Official Apple Support page returned successfully and its HTML was archived. Original visible specification sections were extracted; individual field values have not yet been independently normalized or verified.

extraction.note: Apple's original section headings and visible source text are retained in source order. Connectivity, port, memory, storage and other configurations remain within the same source record where Apple presents them together.

sections.heading: Limited Warranty and Service
sections.source_text:
Every Mac comes with a
one-year limited warranty
and up to 90 days of
complimentary telephone technical support
. Extend your coverage to three years from your Mac original purchase date with the AppleCare Protection Plan. You’ll get direct, one-stop access to Apple’s award-winning technical support for questions about your Mac, macOS, and Apple-branded applications such as Photos, iMovie, GarageBand, Pages, Numbers, Keynote, and more. In addition, you’ll get 24/7 priority access to Apple experts via chat or phone through
getsupport.apple.com
. You can even get local repair service when you visit other countries around the world.
